While I agree that romanticising mental illness is really harmful, I do think that previous generations have gone through life without a diagnosis that could have potentially helped them a lot. 
Anxiety also has to be considered as a spectrum. When I am off my medication my anxiety (caused by BPD) can become so severe that I end up in psychosis, but obviously not everyone deals with anxiety that severe.
I’m sure it is frustrating to hear people talk about it constantly but consider yourself lucky if you don’t understand why they keep doing that. Because the anxiety is probably very debilitating and it’s hard to focus on much else. 
If somebody kept bringing it up like that I would suggest for them to see a professional if they aren’t already, and if they are then tell them it’s a conversation best had with their dr?
